instrument: Siril load + boxselect + stat (every number Siril's); in-house part is the grid bookkeeping and the largest-all-covered-rectangle search
criterion: a box is COVERED when Siril Min >= floor in EVERY channel — the sibling-class sky floor, never mere non-zero (docs/dead-ends.md: lanczos edge-ringing residue passes a Min>0 guard at Min 7-26 on a ~90 sky)
cells_omitted: 4000 per-box records dropped from this file deliberately. The grid is a 2-second LOCAL Siril run and scripts/qa/coverage_frame.py is shipped, so the evidence regenerates on demand — unlike the starlight records, whose cells are kept because re-querying the Gaia archive is network-dependent and slow. The decision's evidence (the Min quantiles, the zero/edge-band counts, the floor and the rectangle) is retained above.
